name: Spectra
author: Kevin Cardwell
description: Audio spectrum for the Omarchy bar. Seven styles from bars and beads to spikes, steps and curves, in stereo, coloured by your theme or the album art; one shared cava capture, and one shader that draws only the frames that change.

schema.label: Style
schema.description: Bars are classic rectangles, Dots light a ladder of cells, Beads ride a disc where the bar would end, Glow drops height for brightness, Spikes taper to a point, Steps holds each band flat, Wave draws the spectrum as a smooth curve.

schema.label: Filled
schema.description: Fill the body under Spikes, Steps and Wave instead of only hinting at it.

schema.label: Direction
schema.description: Bottom grows up from the baseline and Top hangs from the ceiling. Mirror grows out from the centre line, left channel up and right channel down. Butterfly lays the channels side by side with the bass in the middle.

schema.label: Colour
schema.description: Accent, Foreground and Muted are flat theme colours. Gradient fades quiet bands toward muted. Spectrum sweeps hue across the bands, anchored on your accent. Cover takes its colours from the album art of whatever is playing.

schema.label: Peaks
schema.description: Cap leaves a falling cap at each band's recent peak. Trail draws Bars chased by a translucent ghost of that peak. Off shows the level alone.

schema.label: Feel
schema.description: How the spectrum moves. Smooth glides and spreads each peak wide; Punchy snaps to transients and drops fast; Balanced sits between.

schema.label: Bands
schema.description: How many frequency bands to draw.

schema.label: Bar width
schema.description: Width of a single bar in logical pixels.

schema.label: Gap
schema.description: Space between bars in logical pixels.

schema.label: Height (%)
schema.description: How much of the bar's height the spectrum is allowed to use.

schema.label: Fold away when silent
schema.description: Collapse the widget to nothing after a couple of seconds of silence.

schema.label: Audio device
schema.description: PulseAudio source cava listens to. Leave empty to follow the default output. `pactl list sources short` lists the names; a monitor source ends in `.monitor`.

schema.label: Reduced motion
schema.description: Drop the incidental animation — the fold and the fade — and leave only the spectrum itself moving.
